@ a reset of a condition of sample / 4 is at its tick only: the frame 8 gives the init, the frame 9 the value stored at the frame 8
@ the delay with the reset as the argument of a flow gives the value of the frame and the one before it
@ each copy of a par~ has its own delay and its own condition: the second copy is not reset
@ delay~ and vdelay~ with the reset: the line is put back, the frames 8 and 9 read it empty and the frame 10 reads what the frame 8 wrote
@ a when~ in front of the reset: a tick that is stopped resets the delay and the held output, a tick that runs resets and the frames after it hold
@ a when~ after the reset counts the grid of the condition in the frames that run, and reads the value the caller holds
